title: Blogy
description: A minimal, blazing-fast CMS that lets users manage blog content directly from the browser. Supports live Markdown editing, dynamic route generation, and dark/light theme toggle. Built with SvelteKit, TailwindCSS, and simple JSON-based routing. Ideal for developers who want a no-database, markdown-driven blogging platform.

title: ncCmdExe – Netcat Clone with Remote Command Execution
description: A lightweight Netcat clone built using Golang for secure remote command execution. Enables listening on ports, connecting to remote devices, and executing shell commands remotely. Designed with simplicity, cross-platform support, and powerful networking features for ethical hacking, automation, and DevOps use cases.

title: PropertyX – Smart Real Estate App
description: A modern Android app for property listings and management. PropertyX allows users to browse, post, and manage real estate with real-time updates using Firebase. The backend server is written in Go using gRPC for efficient communication. Features include authentication, image uploads, agent/buyer roles, and a clean UI.

title: DepressionGuru – Mental Health Platform
description: A supportive web app where users can anonymously share their struggles and receive guidance from others. Built with Flask, SQLite, and a mysterious yet calming UI. Prioritizes privacy and human connection for mental wellness.
